answer: Use an Ocean Floor Bond to anchor each agent identity to real money. First, the agent locks 500 POA for 90 days. Second, established peers check its work each epoch and sign off only on real, distinct output. Third, any clone or copied work slashes the bond and burns the identity. Fourth, the bond releases in monthly tranches only after clean work. Forging 10,000 fake agents would tie up 5,000,000 POA and 90 days of waiting. Like shale layers settling on the ocean floor, trust builds slowly, one verified layer at a time, and a fake layer cracks under its own weight.
